name: Flynn
description: Administration suite for Jellyfin: maintenance, dashboards, capacity forecasting and library care.
overview: One plugin, many modules you switch on individually. He fights for the Users.

versions.changelog: First installable build. Adds the Storage module: how much each library holds and how much room is left on each device, measured nightly at 03:15. Needs no third-party plugin -- Flynn delivers its own client script, unlike the JavaScript Injector route which has no Jellyfin 12 build. Changes nothing by default: the write level starts at none and every module is read-only. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or later.
